doc: GLM-MoE-DSA (GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM: GLM-5): DeepSeek-V3.2's MLA, router, experts and token indexer (ATTN_TOKEN_INDEXER_V1, the ONE indexer of deepseek-v32: the same spec, tensors and selection) with both rotaries INTERLEAVED — transformers' GlmMoeDsaAttention and GlmMoeDsaIndexer rotate interleaved pairs whatever rope_interleave / indexer_rope_interleave say, so either set to false is refused (the configuration would claim another model). Cross-layer index sharing (indexer_types `shared`: a layer reusing the previous full layer's top-k, GLM-5.1+) is a feature this build does not lower (ATTN_TOKEN_INDEXER_SHARED_V1) and is refused by name; the per-layer kinds are transformers' own derivation (indexer_types, else index_topk_pattern, else index_topk_freq / index_skip_topk_offset). The MTP layer (num_nextn_predict_layers) is not read, as deepseek-v3.

$require_eq: GlmMoeDsaAttention rotates interleaved pairs whatever rope_interleave says
GlmMoeDsaIndexer rotates interleaved pairs whatever indexer_rope_interleave says

$check: indexer_types does not have one entry per layer
glm_moe_dsa: a layer reuses the previous full layer's top-k (indexer_types `shared`): cross-layer index sharing (ATTN_TOKEN_INDEXER_SHARED_V1) is not lowered
